questions.cardText:
[Psychology] According to recent studies, what percentage of our personality traits are estimated to be hereditary?
A. 10%
B. 25%
C. 50%
Answer: C. Research in behavioral genetics involving twins suggests that approximately half of our personality is influenced by our genetic makeup, while the other half is shaped by environmental factors and individual experiences.
questions.en: According to twin studies in behavioural genetics, roughly what percentage of the variation in personality traits is hereditary?
questions.de: Welcher Anteil der Unterschiede in Persönlichkeitsmerkmalen ist laut Zwillingsstudien der Verhaltensgenetik ungefähr erblich (in Prozent)?

timeline.labelEn: Jang, Livesley and Vernon publish a twin study on the heritability of the Big Five personality dimensions
timeline.labelDe: Jang, Livesley und Vernon veröffentlichen eine Zwillingsstudie zur Erblichkeit der Big-Five-Persönlichkeitsdimensionen

questions.notes: Heritability describes variation within a population, not a share of one person's personality. Twin-study estimates for the Big Five range roughly 42–57% (openness 57%, extraversion 54%, conscientiousness 49%, neuroticism 48%, agreeableness 42%); accept 40–60%.

questions.cardText:
[Philosophy] What is utilitarianism?
A. A theory in ethics stating that the best action is the one that maximizes utility
B. A belief that practicality should precede idealism
C. A movement on individuals’ utility
Answer: A.
questions.en: Which theory in ethics holds that the best action is the one that maximizes utility?
questions.de: Welche ethische Theorie besagt, dass die beste Handlung diejenige ist, die den Nutzen maximiert?

timeline.labelEn: Jeremy Bentham publishes An Introduction to the Principles of Morals and Legislation, founding utilitarianism
timeline.labelDe: Jeremy Bentham veröffentlicht „An Introduction to the Principles of Morals and Legislation“ und begründet den Utilitarismus

questions.notes: Card asks for the definition; reversed to ask for the theory from its correct definition (option A). Bentham's book was printed in 1780, published 1789.
